name: HuddleEnd_RebornAndDeer
title: Huddle ending: the boy is reborn, with the deer
description: Ending (huddle at rest by the sea, normal stop point): the unused 'boy is reborn' sequence plays just in front of the huddle, and the unused deer run past. The deer group (Wildlife: deer + birds) is switched off in the shipped level; this mod switches it on and moves the deer trigger onto the huddle's rest spot. That trigger now also starts the reborn sequence (_PM BoyBeautiful, switched off and unconnected in the shipped game): the reborn boy animation (RebornBeautifully) 3.6 m closer to the huddle than authored, then the BoyIsReborn signal. The deer run past about 100 s after the trigger.

operations.note: the reborn state machine is switched off in the level file; on, it waits in 'Wait for end' for >EndNow
deer + birds group, switched off in the level file and never switched on by the game: holds Trigger DeerA, so without it nothing fires
nothing sends >EndNow in the game: the deer trigger (huddle probe) now does, alongside its own >StartDeer
reborn boy 3.6 m closer to where the huddle rests (x 4138); original spot is 7.6 m ahead, the huddle's own centre is inside it
the boy's end position marker, kept with the reborn boy
deer trigger onto the huddle's normal rest spot (x 4138): the huddle stops 3 m short of the original trigger box
